         Combatant c = session.order.get(i);\n                        sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, roll, sort_order) VALUES (\" + quote(session.id) + \", \" +     CombatSession getCombatSession(String id) {\n            synchronized (lock) {\n                List<Map<String, Object>> sessionRows = query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n                if (sessionRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n                Map<String, Object> sessionRow = sessionRows.get(0);\n\n                List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n                List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY sort_order;\");\n                for (Map<String, Object> row : combatantRows) {\n                    combatants.add(new Combatant((String) row.get(\"name\"), toInt(row.get(\"score\")), toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n                }\n\n                CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n                session.round = toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n                session.turnIndex = toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n                List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n                for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                    String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                    session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n                }\n\n                return session;\n            }\n        }\n\n        void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int duration) {\n            synchronized (lock) {\n                execSql(\"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (\" + quote(sessionId) + \", \" + quote(target) + \", \" + quote(condition) + \", \" + duration + \");\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        void advanceCombatSession(CombatSession session, Combatant active) {\n            synchronized (lock) {\n                List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n                sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n                sqls.add(\"UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = \" + session.round + \", turn_index = \" + session.turnIndex + \" WHERE id = \" + quote(session.id) + \";\");\n                sqls.add(\"UPDATE conditions SET remaining_rounds = remaining_rounds - 1 WHERE session_id = \" + quote(session.id) + \" AND target = \" + quote(active.name) + \";\");\n                sqls.add(\"DELETE FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(session.id) + \" AND target = \" + quote(active.name) + \" AND remaining_rounds <= 0;\");\n                sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n                execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        private StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n                int rc = p.waitFor();\n                if (rc != 0) {\n                    throw new RuntimeException(\"sqlite3 failed: \" + output.trim());\n                }\n            } catch (IOException | InterruptedException e) {\n                throw new RuntimeException(e);\n            }\n        }\n\n        private List<Map<String, Object>> query(String sql) handleDiceStats(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not    int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void
